firm_data.firm_description: Rider, Weiner & Frankel, P.C., is one of the preeminent commercial law firms in the Hudson Valley with roots tracing back to 1932. From business formation to mergers and acquisitions, real estate department to complex construction litigation, employment law and human resources, municipal law and estate planning, our attorneys have the experience you need.
notable_facts: The firm has deep roots in the Mid Hudson region.
Represents the largest municipality in Orange County.

email.subject: AI for Rider, Weiner & Frankel, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Justin,

With your firm's deep roots in commercial law since 1932, you're managing complex work across banking, construction litigation, and corporate transactions with a lean team. That's exactly where AI precision matters most.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by New Windsor on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
